title: Morale, Cohesion, Leadership & Discipline
objective: Implement bounded source/profile-scoped strategic morale-check coordination plus visibility-safe cohesion, leadership-influence and discipline evidence projections over completed SCL-01..04 without duplicating Character, Relationship/Reputation, Organization or Combat truth and without executing downstream consequences.

allowed_sources: completed SCL-04 deterministic order coordination/handoff contract
tranche_context.expansion_rule: No context expansion unless a named source is missing or contradictory, changed validation evidence identifies a concrete dependency, canonical authority drifts, or the owner explicitly requests expansion.

source_profile.scope: source/profile-scoped squad/fleet morale only; not a universal Multiversal morale system

resolved_contract.source_check_rule: For the retained source profile, a triggered morale check uses d20 plus the explicit commander's Leadership modifier against source DC 15 as modified only by explicit visible battlefield-condition/profile evidence. SCL-05 generates no random roll and never invents a battlefield modifier.
resolved_contract.failure_effect_rule: The source says failure causes reduced efficiency (example -2 attack rolls) or retreat. SCL-05 may preserve both as visible owner-domain consequence references but cannot auto-select between them, apply the attack modifier, force retreat, mutate Action/Combat/Event state or advance time.
resolved_contract.numeric_morale_gap: The source also mentions -2 enemy morale, restore 10 morale points and victory by morale reaching 0, but supplies no complete initial/max morale pool or universal accumulation model. Those numeric morale-pool statements remain source references only and no canonical morale-point ledger or arithmetic pool is authorized.
resolved_contract.cohesion_rule: ODL-03 remains canonical for organization-politics cohesion using low/mixed/high profile/context-scoped bands. SCL-05 may expose explicit tactical cohesion evidence with the same low/mixed/high labels only when a visible source/profile/context explicitly designates tactical coordination context; it never derives tactical cohesion from ODL-03, member count, formation size, morale result, command title or hidden evidence and creates no second organization cohesion truth store.
resolved_contract.leadership_rule: Leadership influence requires an explicit visible commander/leader reference plus owner/profile evidence. SCL-03 command roles and ODL-04 role/delegation evidence identify relationships/scopes but do not by themselves create a Leadership modifier. The source Inspiring Command +2 morale-roll statement may be represented as a source/profile modifier reference; source morale-point abilities remain reference-only where pool semantics are unresolved.
resolved_contract.discipline_rule: The retained Squad & Fleet source provides no discipline scale, check, threshold or consequence formula. SCL-05 therefore records discipline only through evidence states resolved, unknown, conflict or incompatible with explicit visible profile/context/provenance; no universal discipline band or mechanical modifier is invented.
resolved_contract.relationship_character_rule: MIB-09 remains authoritative for Loyalty/relationship/reputation state and Character-Actors remains authoritative for identity, personality, consent and agency. SCL-05 cannot infer morale, cohesion, leadership or discipline from hidden relationship edges, Character traits or real-world psychological concepts.
resolved_contract.dpl12_boundary: DPL-12 source/profile fear, stress, sanity, trauma and recovery references remain read-only and Condition/Character owners retain live effects. SCL-05 does not convert fear, sanity, stress or trauma into morale automatically and makes no clinical inference.
resolved_contract.handoff_rule: Resolved morale-check results and explicit visible failure-effect references may produce read-only Action, Combat or Event handoff requests only. Canonical owners decide and commit consequences exactly once; SCL-05 receipts are not replayable world-state truth and cannot double-apply effects.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Permission/visibility filtering occurs before trigger detection, commander/leadership evidence, morale result, cohesion/discipline evidence, consequence references, counts, summaries, search, provenance, deterministic receipts or AI context. Hidden existence and cardinality remain undisclosed.
resolved_contract.unknown_conflict_rule: Missing, unknown, conflicting or incompatible visible evidence remains conservative. SCL-05 never guesses a roll, modifier, battlefield DC adjustment, failure consequence, cohesion band or discipline state merely to complete a result.
resolved_contract.determinism_rule: Stable check id, subject/profile/context ids, explicit roll/modifier/DC evidence ids and owner-domain handoff ids determine deterministic receipt order. Presentation prose and hidden evidence are excluded from receipt truth.
resolved_contract.ai_rule: AI may advise only where separately governed. SCL-05 invokes no provider and grants no autonomous command, roll generation, adjudication, permission, owner mutation or completion authority.
resolved_contract.persistence: No durable SCL-05 morale/cohesion/discipline ledger or migration. Migration 0022 remains unreserved.

acceptance_contract.red_rule: Acceptance/proof/profile/verifier land before production contract/panel and fail at intended missing production imports after invariants/install pass on both self-hosted lanes.
acceptance_contract.green_rule: Exactly one SCL-05 current-family profile passes exact-head repository health, self-hosted Linux, self-hosted Windows and deterministic comparison with zero historical predecessor fanout.

preserved_boundaries: ODL-03 organization-politics cohesion, ODL-04 role/delegation, MIB-09 relationship/reputation, Character-Actors, DPL-12, Permission/visibility and ordinary Action/Combat/Event owners remain authoritative.
SCL-05 may deterministically resolve only explicit source/profile morale-check evidence; it executes no Action/Combat/Event consequence and creates no universal morale-point pool.
No owner mutation, AI autonomous command/adjudication, hidden-data reveal, duplicate ledger, durable persistence or migration 0022 is authorized.
SCL-06+, MAL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
next_action: Land acceptance/proof/profile/verifier first, establish genuine matching cross-platform RED, then add the production contract/panel and carry exact-head GREEN through application merge, AIOC closeout and SCL-06 selection in this owner Continue.
